sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2024
sources.text: While underway, the master was alerted by the 3rd Engineer to five perpetrators armed with long knives in the engine room. The 3rd Engineer was tied up by the perpetrators but managed to alert the bridge about the incident. The master sounded the general alarm immediately, and the crew conducted a thorough search onboard the ship. However, the perpetrators had already escaped. Some generator spare parts were reported missing and the 3rd Engineer, who was punched on the forehead, suffered minor injury.
